title: Read a text file in the browser
why_it_matters: No upload, no server: the data never leaves the device.
explanation: A File has a text() method that returns a promise of its contents. Use it for txt, csv, json and code files. For binary files use arrayBuffer() instead. It's the base of every in-browser viewer.
try_it: Load a JSON file and pretty-print it with JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2).
